votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Wharton, seconded by Council Member Puy to enter into Closed Session for the purposes of a strategy session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation; and for attorney-client matters that are privileged pursuant to Utah Code § 78B-1-137, and for other lawful purposes that satisfy the pertinent requirements of the Utah Open and Public Meetings Act.
votes.description: The Council voted to enter into a closed session to discuss pending or reasonably imminent litigation and privileged attorney-client matters.

votes.motion: Moved by Council Member Dugan, seconded by Council Member Young to end the closed session.
votes.description: The Council voted to conclude the closed session that had been held to discuss litigation and attorney-client matters.
